translated_text: 16124 Liginiae 4.2.5. V1.40 The letter of the 20th, my Bobeten, reached me today. It's a free gift that made me so happy!! The certificate was sent the same day I received your telegram, I think Sunday the 21st, it probably arrived at your place today. So maybe you can send it Sunday or Monday and it will arrive Tuesday or Wednesday. Maybe it will take longer, because the bureaucracy must be very bad correspondence of the [illegible]. The solution you found with the photographer is very nice indeed. But when are you going to start working for him? It's fortunate that we buy everything together. I myself need a lot of things for the baby and for myself—for myself?! I receive things for myself. I'm waiting to be in a big city, because here everything is very expensive and you can't find much. We also need to see what we absolutely need in our apartment (sheets for the summer bed, sheets for the winter bed). It seems like we'll have everything we need, there's nothing to do but buy certain things, otherwise we'll be unhappy because of a few details that aren't worth it. I hope that when you're demobilized we'll already have the package from Paris and we can buy what you need with you. If not, we'll have to do it by then. But in any case, you must cherish my old Bob, always clean-shaven (yes, perfectly). He's well-dressed, at least we're both in clean clothes that I like, it's enough that I'm ugly enough to make me cry now. You, at least, must be handsome and please me. My darling, I haven't always succeeded in spending my life with you, but if you're there, we'll be together. You'll see, we'll leave together no matter what happens to us. In any case, I burn with desire to kiss you, to hold you against me like a little boy who left a long time ago and came back after a thousand and one adventures – Goodbye my little one, my darling Bob – I'm waiting for you, I'm waiting for you so much [illegible] 04 620 Tramite LO ta ta Vaviya Ac 25 40 CORR EZ FM GIN Mr. Robert Zweigenthal 45 Bon. 175 lie Camp d'Agde Agde 40 C Exp. Mme E. Kreip cuttal Liginiae (Corrèze)
